mapper.select: SELECT t.union_id AS unionId, t1.open_id AS openId, t1.mini_open_id AS miniOpenId, t1.nick_name as nickName, t2.user_id AS userId, t2.user_name AS userName, t2.user_type AS userType, t2.phonenumber As phonenumber, t2.`PASSWORD` AS passwd FROM bs_wx_user_link t inner JOIN bs_wx_user t1 ON t1.union_id = t.union_id LEFT JOIN sys_user t2 ON t2.user_id = t.user_id WHERE t.union_id = #{unionId} AND t.is_active = 'Y' AND t.delete_flag = '0' And t2.DEL_FLAG = '0' and t2.STATUS = '0' LIMIT 1
SELECT t.industry_code AS industryCode FROM bs_wx_user_link t WHERE t.union_id = #{unionId} AND t.is_active = 'Y' LIMIT 1
SELECT t.RECEIVE_MSG AS receiveMsg FROM bs_wx_user_link t WHERE t.union_id = #{unionId} AND t.is_active = 'Y' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: update bs_wx_user_link t set t.is_active = 'N', t.update_time = now() WHERE t.union_id = #{unionId} AND t.is_active = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bs_wx_user_link ( union_id, user_id, is_active, industry_code, delete_flag, create_by, create_time ) SELECT #{unionId} as union_id, t.user_id, 'Y', #{tradeId}, '0', t.user_name, now() FROM sys_user AS t WHERE t.user_name = #{userName} and t.DEL_FLAG = '0' and t.STATUS = '0'
mapper.update: update bs_wx_user_link t set t.is_active = 'Y', t.industry_code = #{tradeId}, t.update_time = now() WHERE t.union_id = #{unionId} AND t.user_id in (select t2.user_id from sys_user t2 where t2.user_name = #{userName} and t2.DEL_FLAG = '0' and t2.STATUS = '0')
mapper.select: select bwu.OPEN_ID openId from bs_wx_user bwu inner join bs_wx_user_link bwul on (bwu.UNION_ID = bwul.UNION_ID and bwul.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y') where bwul.USER_ID = #{userId} and bwu.OPEN_ID is not null and bwu.DELETE_FLAG = '0'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM bs_wx_colony WHERE union_id = #{unionId} AND delete_flag = '0'
SELECT colony_code FROM bs_wx_colony WHERE union_id = #{unionId} AND delete_flag = '0'

select `platform_code` AS colonyCode, platform_name AS colonyName, general_url AS generalUrl, program_url AS programUrl, colony_version AS colonyVersion, node_alias AS nodeAlias from vm_platform_data_config where delete_flag = 0 AND platform_code = #{platformCode}
SELECT OPEN_ID FROM bs_wx_user WHERE UNION_ID = #{unionId}
